title: Vat Phou & Riverside Gems Full-Day
headline: A UNESCO temple, a royal town and a quiet return on the Mekong
price_note: From $XX per person — Standard. Comfort upgrades and guide available.
dream: Vat Phou is not a quick photo stop. This day gives time for the museum, the long sacred causeway and the climb to the holy spring — then Champasak town and a two-hour boat back to Pakse on the Mekong. The most complete cultural day trip from Pakse.
highlights: Full visit of Vat Phou UNESCO World Heritage Site
Walk in Champasak, former royal town
Return to Pakse by private boat (about 2 hours)

itinerary.title: Pakse – Vat Phou – Champasak – Mekong – Pakse
itinerary.body: Morning at the Vat Phou complex: museum, electric shuttle, ancient causeway and sacred spring. Short drive to Hong Nang Sida. Walk through Champasak. Return to Pakse by boat (about two hours). Vehicle journey: approximately 90 km + boat return. Meals: not included.

included: All entrance fees mentioned in the program
excluded: Guide (on request), lunch, tips, insurance, personal expenses
upgrades: Qualified guide (English or French) — strongly recommended for Vat Phou
Extra time in Champasak town or at the temple
